tools.name: check_domain
tools.description: Check whether one domain name is available to register at pekt, a Norwegian domain service, and what it costs: first-year and renewal price in NOK per year including 25 % Norwegian VAT. If the extension is not sold, the reason is given. Always show the user the returned buy_url.

tools.name: suggest_domains
tools.description: Check one name (e.g. mycompany) across the most popular extensions (.no, .com, .net, .org, .io, .app ...) and return which are available, with prices in NOK per year incl. 25 % VAT and a buy_url for each.

tools.name: requirements
tools.description: What buying one extension (TLD) at pekt involves: whether it is for sale, price per action (register, renew, transfer), who may own it (e.g. .eu needs an EU/EEA holder, .se and .nu need an ID number) and registry notices. Prices in NOK incl. 25 % VAT.

tools.name: list_extensions
tools.description: List the domain extensions pekt sells with first-year and renewal price in NOK per year incl. 25 % VAT. Default is the most popular ones; pass a category for others.
